payload.title: Rank 4 pointed Z4 row resolved as partial low-rank ribbon progress
payload.top_notice: The rank4-pointed-z4 family row now has four hash-bound ribbon realization snapshots using an explicit cyclic Z4 abelian cocycle with parameters m in {2,6,10,14}. The low-rank ribbon catalog remains partial: 7 rows resolved, 7 rows blocked, and formal scan-plan generation is still disabled.
validated_behaviors: The four rank4 pointed Z4 snapshots pass validate_formal_evidence.

Each Z4 snapshot records an explicit omega_m(a,b,c)=zeta16^(m*a*(b+c-[b+c]_4)) associator, R-symbol table, twist table, pivotal scalars, evaluation/coevaluation data, basis/gauge, and field embedding.
Exact exponent scans check pentagon, both hexagon equations, monodromy nondegeneracy, twist equals R_aa, and ribbon/pivotal compatibility.
A strict-associator Z4 negative control still satisfies pentagon but fails both hexagon checks, preventing silent use of FR-only or strict pointed data for this even cyclic row.
The v8 catalog passes validate_low_rank_ribbon_catalog as PARTIAL_RIBBON_REFINEMENT_PROGRESS.
The v8 readiness artifact keeps scan_plan_generation_allowed=false.
